sentences.text: The Dp Act vs In Re : Rakib Sk @ Sk Rakib

on 16 January, 2024
16.01.2024
tkm/ct 28 C.R.M. (Db) 127 of 2024
sl no. 59

In Re : An application for bail under section 439 of the Code of Criminal
 Procedure in connection with Raghunathganj Ps case no. 593 of 2023
 dated 17.7.2023 under sections 498A/302/34 Ipc and sections 3/4 of
 the Dp Act
 And

In Re : Rakib Sk @ Sk Rakib ....petitioner
 Ms. S Hasin
 ...... for the petitioner
 Ms. Arijit Ganguly
 Ms. Kum Kum Mitra
 ...... for the State
 1.
Petitioner is in custody for 125 days.
He submits he is the father-in-law of the victim housewife.
He has been falsely implicated in the case.
2. Learned lawyer for the State opposes the bail prayer.
3. We have considered the materials on record.
Victim housewife was murdered at the matrimonial home.
Petitioner was present at the place of occurrence.
4. In view of the gravity of offence and prima facie involvement of the petitioner therein we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
5. Accordingly, prayer for bail is rejected.
